rows.grounds: compound adverb indicating time after one and a half yāmas
fused form of sakṛt and eva

items.question: When should the bali be offered around the goddess after one and a half yāmas?
premises: bali offering follows one and a half yāmas
items.inference: The ritual timing is one and a half yāmas later, with a single circumambulatory offering.
items.plain_english: After one and a half yāmas, O goddess, [the offering is made] around [her], once, and...
